offices.name: United States Patent and Trademark Office

definitions.text: Defined in 37 CFR 1.27(a) as a person, a small business concern or a nonprofit organization. Small business concerns follow SBA size standards (13 CFR 121.801 to 121.805).

Qualifies as a small entity, has been named as inventor on no more than four previously filed applications, and had prior-year gross income within the maximum qualifying gross income (three times the US median household income).

definitions.category: Micro entity (institution of higher education basis)
definitions.text: Qualifies as a small entity and either is mainly employed by a US institution of higher education or has assigned, or is obliged to assign, ownership to one.

fee_reductions.fees: Most patent fees (filing, search, examination, issue, maintenance and others; some fees such as document supply fees are not reduced)

Small entity amounts listed in the USPTO fee schedule (e.g. transmittal fee $285.00, small entity $114.00)

fee_reductions.fees: PCT: international-stage transmittal, search, supplemental search and preliminary examination fees; national stage basic, search and examination fees

support.name: Patent Pro Bono Program
support.text: Connects inventors and small businesses with limited financial resources to volunteer patent attorneys and agents who help them file at no cost for legal services.

support.name: Pro Se Assistance Program
support.text: Gives procedural help, not legal advice, to independent inventors who file without a registered attorney or agent.

support.name: Inventors Assistance Center
support.text: Answers general questions on patent rules, forms, application formats and fees, and routes callers to the right USPTO staff.

offices.name: European Patent Office

European Commission definition (Recommendation 2003/361/EC): an independent company with fewer than 250 staff and turnover below EUR 50 million and/or balance sheet below EUR 43 million.

fee_reductions.as_published: a 30% reduction in all main fees in the patent grant procedure
fee_reductions.fees: Filing, search, examination, designation and grant fees, and renewal fees

support.name: Unitary Patent compensation scheme
support.text: A EUR 500 lump sum for translation costs to SMEs, natural persons, non-profits, universities and public research organisations based in an EU member state whose application was filed in an EU language other than English, French or German.

offices.name: Japan Patent Office

definitions.text: A company within the employee or capital limit for its industry (e.g. manufacturing up to 300 employees or JPY 300 million capital; retail up to 50 employees or JPY 50 million), not under the management of large enterprises. Foreign SMEs qualify on the same conditions.
A corporation with 20 employees or fewer (5 or fewer in commerce or services), not under the management of large enterprises.
A corporation established no more than 10 years ago with capital of no more than JPY 300 million, not under the management of large enterprises.
Individuals on public assistance or exempt from municipal tax, income tax or enterprise tax.

fee_reductions.fees: Request for examination fee; patent fees for years 1 to 10

fee_reductions.category: Micro enterprise / small and medium startup

offices.name: Ministry of Intellectual Property of the Republic of Korea (formerly the Korean Intellectual Property Office)

support.name: Public-interest Patent Attorney Center (공익변리사 특허상담센터)

offices.name: China National Intellectual Property Administration

Enterprises whose taxable income in the previous year was below RMB 1 million.
Public institutions, social organisations and non-profit research institutions (no income threshold).

resources.title: IP for Business

resources.title: WIPO IP Diagnostics

resources.title: IP Management Clinics for SMEs

resources.title: PCT Newsletter: PCT SME Support Series

pct_international.fee: International filing fee (Schedule of Fees item 1, PCT Rule 15.2)
pct_international.reduction: Fixed reduction for electronic filing: CHF 100 (item 4(a): request not in character coded format), CHF 200 (item 4(b): request in character coded format), CHF 300 (item 4(c): request, description, claims and abstract in character coded format). Each receiving Office publishes the equivalent in its currency.
pct_international.who_qualifies: Any applicant filing in electronic form as provided for in the Administrative Instructions (e.g. ePCT) with a receiving Office that accepts electronic filing.
pct_international.fee_table_or_item: Schedule of Fees, item 4(a)-(c); PCT Fee Tables, Table I(a) column 'E-filing reductions'; PCT Applicant's Guide para. 5.189
pct_international.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, International Phase, paragraph 5.189

pct_international.fee: International filing fee incl. fee per sheet over 30 (item 1, after any item 4 reduction), supplementary search handling fee (item 2, PCT Rule 45bis.2), handling fee (item 3, PCT Rule 57.2)
pct_international.who_qualifies: Item 5(a): applicant who is a natural person and a national of and resident in a listed State (per capita GDP below USD 25,000 on the UN 10-year average at constant 2005 USD, and fewer than 10 international applications per year per million population or fewer than 50 per year in absolute numbers by its natural-person nationals and residents). Item 5(b): applicant, natural person or not, who is a national of and resident in a listed State classified by the UN as a least developed country. Several applicants: each must meet 5(a) or 5(b). No beneficial owner at filing who would not meet the criteria; 2017 PCT Assembly Understanding: applicants must be sole and true owners with no obligation to assign or license to an ineligible party. Lists of States: WIPO list applicable on or after 7 January 2025.
pct_international.fee_table_or_item: Schedule of Fees, item 5(a) and 5(b); PCT Fee Tables footnote 2; WIPO list 'Applicability of 90% Reduction in Certain PCT Fees (applicable on or after 7 January 2025)'
pct_international.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, International Phase, paragraph 5.188

pct_international.fee: Transmittal fee payable to the International Bureau as receiving Office (RO/IB)
pct_international.who_qualifies: Applicants who meet the conditions for the 90% reduction of the international filing fee.
pct_international.fee_table_or_item: PCT Fee Tables, Table I(a) footnote 14 and introductory note

Micro entity amount in Annex E (US)

isa_ipea.criteria: As for the JPO search fee.

isa_ipea.as_published: Reduced if the application is filed in Japanese by eligible applicants (Table I(a) footnote 18; Annex C(JP)). No rate stated.
isa_ipea.criteria: Japanese-language filing; eligibility per JPO reduction scheme.

isa_ipea.fee: International search fee, supplementary international search fee, international preliminary examination fee

isa_ipea.fee: International search fee, supplementary international search fee, international preliminary examination fee

national_phase.fees: Filing fee; European or supplementary European search fee; examination fee (plus a further reduction of 30% of the search fee effectively paid, including the international search fee where the EPO was ISA); designation fee; fee for grant; renewal fees for the European patent application
national_phase.category: microenterprise, natural person, non-profit organisation, university, public research organisation
national_phase.criteria: Declaration under Rule 7b(1) EPC; microenterprise as defined in Commission Recommendation 2003/361/EC; any nationality or domicile; fewer than five applications (EP or Euro-PCT) in the five years before the relevant date (for Euro-PCT: date of entry into the European phase); each applicant must qualify. In force 1 April 2024 (CA/D 16/23; OJ EPO 2024, A3 and A8). Applies only from European phase entry (Rule 159 EPC acts), not to PCT international-phase fees.
national_phase.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, National Chapter, Procedure (EP), paragraph EP.14a

national_phase.category: microenterprise, SME, natural person, non-profit organisation, university, public research organisation (language reduction)
national_phase.criteria: Residence or principal place of business in an EPC contracting state whose official language is not English, French or German; the request for examination is filed in an official language of that state, with a declaration of entitlement (Rule 7b(1) EPC; Form 1200 or 1011). Where the EPO established the international preliminary report on patentability, the 75% reduction applies first and then 30% of the rest: 82.5% in total.
national_phase.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, National Chapter, Procedure (EP), paragraph EP.14

national_phase.fees: Basic national fee, search fee, examination fee, application size fee, excess claims fees, and other 35 USC 371 fees listed with small and micro entity amounts
national_phase.criteria: Small entity: 37 CFR 1.27, written assertion (may be made on Form PTO-1390 or by paying the exact small entity basic national fee). Micro entity: 37 CFR 1.29, gross income or institution of higher education basis, certification required. Rates: Guide para. US.19.
national_phase.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, National Chapter, Summary (US)

national_phase.fees: Fee for request for examination; annual fees

national_phase.fees: Filing fee, fee for request for examination, annual fees for years 1 to 3, fee for request for scope confirmation trial
national_phase.category: natural person who is also the inventor
national_phase.criteria: Applicant is a natural person and the inventor; filing fee reduced by 30% only where the applicant files more than 20 applications per year (Annex KR national phase). Not an SME scheme.
national_phase.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, National Chapter, Summary (KR)

national_phase.criteria: No SME reduction is listed in the PCT Applicant's Guide, National Chapter, Summary (KR) or Annex KR.I.
national_phase.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, National Chapter, Summary (KR)

national_phase.fees: Filing fee and additional filing fee not payable where CNIPA acted as receiving Office and ISA. Examination fee not payable where CNIPA established the international search report and the international preliminary report on patentability. 50% of the examination fee refunded on early withdrawal.
national_phase.criteria: The Guide lists no SME or individual reduction for the national phase in China. These exemptions depend on CNIPA's role in the international phase.
national_phase.citation: PCT Applicant's Guide, National Chapter, Summary (CN)

pct_wide_sme.status: None. The PCT Schedule of Fees (Regulations as in force from 1 January 2026) has no reduction for SMEs, startups or universities; its only reductions are e-filing (item 4) and the 90% reduction for natural persons from listed States and applicants from least developed countries (item 5). A proposal by Brazil for university fee reductions was discussed in the PCT Working Group 2016-2019; at the 12th session (2019) the Chair noted wide support but that some Group B delegations could not agree at that stage. No later adoption found.
